newsitem.title: USA: Genentech says Pulmozyme cleared for CF.
newsitem.headline: Genentech says Pulmozyme cleared for CF.

text.p: Genentech Inc said on Monday its drug Pulmozyme Inhalation Solution, has been cleared by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration as an aerosol treatment for advanced cystic fibrosis, also called CF.
Pulmozyme was originally approved by the FDA in December 1993 to manage mild to moderate CF along with standard therapies that reduced respiratory tract infections.

In a statement, Genentech said Pulmozyme was safe and generally well-tolerated in patients with advanced CF. Side effects were similar to those in patients with mild to moderate disease and included rashes, chest pain and others.
